description: This PHP source file defines the DroppingStream class, a stream decorator that drops data once a maximum size is exceeded. It implements the StreamInterface and is part of the GuzzleHttp PSR7 implementation.

classes.name: DroppingStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that drops data when the stream exceeds a specified maximum length. Implements the StreamInterface via delegation and uses StreamDecoratorTrait.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DroppingStream with an underlying stream and a maximum length limit.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the underlying stream, dropping data if the maximum length has been exceeded.
